title: 第21章 化身甲方把圣主当老板娘使唤第22章 准备做鸡精第一位幸运首座
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
瑶池圣主频频点头，用心记下林东方的每一句话。
这些安排关乎到瑶池圣地的未来啊！
别的不说，单说火灵儿，这些天的进步只能用恐怖来形容。
修炼速度比之前快了十倍不止。
还有那御兽峰的程小云，现在更是在朝力之极致的路上走去。
林东方又想了想，小声道，“我还打算这妙音峰上开辟一块菜地什么的…”
自己种点葱啥的，没事整个小葱卷煎饼，美滋滋。
“无妨，你大胆的做，等你师父出关我自会解释。”
瑶池圣主很霸气的一挥手。
“一大一小两个烤箱。”
“大的要能放进去一头牛，小的放进去两只鸡即可。”
“火力不用特别高，但是一定要均匀，而且还可以自由调整内部通风与否。”
“一个手摇磨盘，这个要有空间法阵，可以磨盘下要能多碾东西，但是外面看起来小。”
“烤箱和磨盘越快做出来越好。”
“还有锅，刻画法阵的锅用起来不太顺手，特别是用来卤鸡卤肉总是觉得差了一点。”
林东方此时化作一个合格的甲方，疯狂提出各种要求。
瑶池圣主认真记下。
以瑶池的底蕴和实力，这些玩意一天之内做不出来都属于丢人！
“就要那种造型普通的大铁锅，大一些，一次能卤二百斤肉或者二十只鸡。”
“材料无所谓，但是加热和导热要方便一些。”

“要六口大的。”
“正常炒菜的小铁锅也要六口，还有十个蒸笼，要和那六口大锅相匹配。”
“还要多盖两间卤肉小屋。”
“分别做盐水鸭，盐水鹅。”
听到这里，瑶池圣主嘴里忽然冒出了点口水。
盐水鸭…盐水鹅？
她千年前还是小修士的时候在凡人城池中吃过。
那鲜香的滋味已经尘封在她的记忆深处，此时又缭绕了出来，勾动了她肚子里的馋虫。
林东方不打算给那一百五十人准备像是土豆炖牛肉那样的饭菜。
太累了。
而且单以道韵来说，熏鸡和卤牛肉要更多一些。
所以不如直接多做些卤味。
到时候每人几斤肉，一只鸡，一只鸭，或者一只大鹅。
公平好分！
他这边每天卤一些，也不会很累。
content_en:
The Holy Master of Yaochi nodded frequently and took note of every word Lin Dongfang said.
These arrangements are related to the future of Yaochi Holy Land!
Let alone anything else, Huo Ling'er's progress these days can only be described as terrifying.
The cultivation speed is more than ten times faster than before.
And Cheng Xiaoyun from the Beast Control Peak is now on the road to reaching the ultimate level of power.
Lin Dongfang thought for a while and whispered, "I also plan to open a vegetable field or something on Miaoyin Peak..."
Grow some scallions yourself, roll them into pancakes, and enjoy it.
"It doesn't matter, just do it boldly. I will explain it when your master comes out."
The Holy Lord of Yaochi waved his hand domineeringly.
"Two ovens, one big and one small."
"The big one needs to be able to fit a cow, and the small one can fit two chickens."
“The firepower doesn’t have to be particularly high, but it must be even and the internal ventilation can be freely adjusted.”
"A hand-operated millstone. This one needs to have a space array. It can grind more things under the millstone, but it looks small from the outside."
“The quicker the oven and grinder can make it, the better.”
"There is also a pot. The pot that depicts the magic circle is not very easy to use, especially when it is used to braise chicken and meat. I always feel it is a bit inferior."
At this time, Lin Dongfang turned into a qualified Party A and made various demands crazily.
The Holy Lord of Yaochi took note of it carefully.
With Yaochi’s background and strength, it would be a shame if these things could not be made in one day!
"It needs a big iron pot with an ordinary shape. It's bigger and can braise two hundred kilograms of meat or twenty chickens at a time."
"The material doesn't matter, but heating and heat conduction are more convenient."
"I want one big enough for six people."
"Normal cooking requires six small iron pots, and ten steamers, which must match the six large pots."
“We need to build two more braised meat huts.”
"Make salted duck and salted goose respectively."
Hearing this, Holy Master Yaochi suddenly had some saliva coming out of his mouth.
Salted duck... salted goose?
She ate it in a mortal city thousands of years ago when she was a young monk.
The delicious taste had been sealed in the depths of her memory, but now it came out again, stimulating the greed in her stomach.
Lin Dongfang didn't plan to prepare meals like potatoes and beef stew for the one hundred and fifty people.
So tired.
And in terms of Daoyun alone, there are more smoked chicken and braised beef.
So it’s better to just make more braised food.
At that time, each person will have a few kilograms of meat, a chicken, a duck, or a goose.
Fair points!
If he eats some salt every day, he won't be very tired.
